name: Chijiwa Arisu
source:
Arisu is in 1st year and she’s a member of the festival committee, she’s very cheery and is kind to everyone and brightens up the atmosphere when she’s there. She would rather listen to other people than talk herself. Due to all of this, it is impossible for Hitori (or anyone else) to dislike her. She quite often says “That’s ecchi, isn’t that right~~”. Despite her size and age, she is very well-endowed and so she gets perved on by some guys which really annoys her.

[From [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/06/12/preview-yomehapi-you-make-happy/]Liemyx's blog[/url]]
